# FxTone (enum)

`import { FxTone } from '@fixtures/single-entry';`

Also exported from: `@fixtures/single-entry` as `FxButtonTone`

Visual tone of a component.

Drives the color and the icon.

```ts
export enum FxTone {
  Neutral = 'neutral',
  Success = 'success',
  Warning = 'warning',
  Danger = 'danger',
}
```
